segments.headline: THE CATCH
segments.text: GTA 6 is out, Black Friday is here, and the deals have a catch: the thing you want most isn't on sale. Here's what actually is, checked on November twentieth.
segments.text_es: GTA 6 ya salió, llega el Black Friday, y las ofertas tienen trampa: lo que más quieres no está rebajado. Esto es lo que sí, revisado el veinte de noviembre.

segments.headline: GTA 6 ITSELF: FULL PRICE
segments.text: First, the game. Deal trackers still see GTA 6 at full price at US stores, seventy nine ninety nine. New games almost never drop in launch week, so if you see it cheaper, check it's the right console and edition.
segments.text_es: Primero, el juego. GTA 6 sigue a precio completo en tiendas de Estados Unidos, setenta y nueve noventa y nueve. Si lo ves más barato, revisa la consola y la edición.

segments.headline: GTA 6 CONTROLLER: ~$85
segments.text: The GTA 6 Edition DualSense isn't on Sony's sale either. It's about eighty five dollars and often out of stock. Buy it for the look, not the price.
segments.text_es: El DualSense edición GTA 6 tampoco está en oferta. Cuesta unos ochenta y cinco dólares y suele agotarse. Cómpralo por el diseño, no por el precio.

segments.headline: DUALSENSE: $54
segments.text: The real deal is the regular DualSense: about fifty four dollars, down from seventy four, at Amazon and PlayStation Direct. GTA 6 sessions run long, so a second controller means one charges while you play.
segments.text_es: La oferta real es el DualSense normal: unos cincuenta y cuatro dólares, antes setenta y cuatro. Con un segundo mando, uno carga mientras juegas.

segments.headline: PULSE ELITE: ~$110
segments.text: Sony's Pulse Elite headset is about a hundred and ten dollars, down from a hundred and fifty, according to TechRadar and Shattered. Good for late-night Vice City.
segments.text_es: El headset Pulse Elite de Sony está a unos ciento diez dólares, antes ciento cincuenta, según TechRadar y Shattered.

segments.headline: STORAGE: 212 GB
segments.text: And storage. GTA 6 needs up to two hundred twelve gigabytes. The big two terabyte SSD deal, about three hundred dollars, ended on November fifteenth, so watch for it on Black Friday, November twenty seventh. Try the free space fixes first.
segments.text_es: Y el almacenamiento. GTA 6 ocupa hasta doscientos doce gigas. La gran oferta del SSD de dos teras terminó el quince de noviembre; vigílala el veintisiete. Prueba antes los trucos gratis.

segments.headline: LINKS BELOW
segments.text: I put links to all of these in the description, plus a free Prime trial for fast delivery. Prices change fast, so check before you buy. What are you grabbing this Black Friday? Tell me in the comments.
